title: Susan L. Fucci | Obituaries | rutlandherald.com
text:
Susan L. Fucci POULTNEY — Susan Lynn Fucci, age 70, of Poultney, Vermont passed away on September 12, 2026. She was born November 4th in Rutland, Vermont to Louis and Marilyn Fucci. Susan Fucci was a devoted nurse. She faithfully served the Rutland area for over forty years. Throughout her career, she helped countless patients and touched many lives through her dedication and presence. Those who knew Susan knew her as caring, hardworking, and devoted. Her legacy can be found in the lives she cared for and the family she loved. Susan was preceded in death by her parents, brother, Gregorgy Fucci, son-in-law, Justin Garvey, and grandson Isaac Christy. She will be deeply missed by her husband, David Boelke, her children Katie Garvey [Dan], Kristen Christy [Brian] and Ellena [Ryan] and her grandchildren Jenna, John, Noah, Maggie, and Ruby, sister-in-law, Shelia Fucci and niece Maria Fucci and nephews Alex and Gregory Fucci who will carry her memory with them always. A celebration of life will be held on September 18, 2026 from 1-3pm at Barnard Funeral Home 3186 US-7, Pittsford, VT 05763.
Susan L. Fucci
